label: Retaliation against a harassment reporter — maximum criminal fine
appliesTo: A sanction against the responsible party, alongside imprisonment of up to three years. It is not a payment to the worker: compensation needs its own legal basis and its own assessment.
why: Quoted to workers as if it were a payout. Someone who reads it that way files expecting ₩30m and treats the real remedies — reinstatement, the labour office, a civil claim — as a consolation prize.

history.source: Labor Standards Act, art. 76-3(6) penalty provision
history.note: Administrative fines for the employer's own harassment and for failing the investigation duty are separate and lower.
